My name is Chandrakumar. I am from Kollam district. I have come to this altar to share my testimony about the healing I received.
I thank Mother Mary and Jesus for giving me the grace to come here and share this testimony. On 8/1/2024 — I made the covenant for the first time.
I was abroad, and during my leave I came here and took the covenant. But just as Father had said,
I was not able to complete that covenant. Before I could, I had to return.
Even then, every night before sleeping and every morning after waking up, I continued to pray to Mother Mary and to Jesus.
And then, on 7 February 2025, I came back home. On 7 February, around five in the evening, I suddenly had severe chest pain.
When I say chest pain, it was an unbearable pain. After about an hour, the pain shifted down to my lower abdomen. We went to the hospital, took medicines, and came back.
By around 9 at night, I could no longer stand.
Again we called a vehicle and went to the hospital. Then they shifted me to Medicity Hospital.
After the X-ray and scanning, the doctor said my intestine had ruptured — an ulcer had burst.
